scenarios.observation_definition: Ideal synthetic field reports except named injections, with sampling time and epoch.
safe_state_rules: Independent oracle evaluates retention, power and connector-event hazards.
limitations: MODEL VERIFICATION ONLY: no physical validation or controller comparison.
